compatibility.part: Roomba i3+ EVO vs. Roomba i3 EVO
compatibility.detail: iRobot describes i3+ EVO as a vacuum with a Clean Base; the i3 EVO can use that base as a separate accessory. The e/i/j kit covers i-series robot consumables, but Clean Base bags are only needed when the self-emptying dock is installed.

compatibility.part: Vacuum-only i3+ EVO vs. Combo i3+
compatibility.detail: Combo i3+ (3574) is a different vacuum-and-mop setup. The standard kit listing names Combo i5 and j5 but does not establish compatibility with Combo i3+; use a part listing that explicitly names your Combo model.

The filter, dual rubber brushes and edge brush install on the robot. The disposable bag belongs in the Clean Base. iRobot lists the i3+ EVO as a compatible Clean Base model; bag compatibility alone does not prove fit for robot parts.

All four linked consumable listings are iRobot-branded. The roller-brush refill kit also contains filters and edge brushes; the other cards offer those parts individually and Clean Base bags separately.

careTip: Roomba e/i/j filters are not washable: tap debris off and keep them dry. Remove hair from both main brush ends and their caps before deciding the rollers need replacing. If the Clean Base has a solid red light, check that the bag is present and seated correctly; a missing or poorly seated bag can trigger the same signal as a full bag.

questions.question: Do Roomba i3 EVO and i3+ EVO use the same robot parts?
questions.answer: iRobot's e/i/j refill kit covers i-series robot consumables. The i3+ package includes a Clean Base, while i3 EVO may have a standard dock; buy Clean Base bags only if that self-emptying dock is installed.

questions.question: Will this i3+ EVO refill kit fit Roomba Combo i3+?
questions.answer: The standard e/i/j kit listing names Combo i5 and j5, but does not name Combo i3+. Since Combo i3+ is a separate vacuum-and-mop model, verify each replacement against a Combo i3+ specific listing before ordering.

questions.question: How often should I replace Roomba i3+ EVO filters and brushes?
questions.answer: iRobot recommends replacing the filter every 2 months and the dual rubber brushes every 6–12 months. Clean the filter and main brushes weekly, or twice weekly in homes with pets. Clean the edge brush monthly and replace it when worn or damaged.

questions.question: Are these genuine iRobot replacement parts?
questions.answer: Yes. The filter, e/i/j replenishment kit, edge-sweeping brushes and Clean Base bags are iRobot-branded listings. Check part numbers and the selected pack on Amazon before ordering because listing variations can change.

questions.question: Does the Roomba i3+ EVO include a Clean Base?
questions.answer: Yes. iRobot's i3+ EVO product page lists one Clean Base Automatic Dirt Disposal and two dirt-disposal bags in the box. The i3 EVO is a separate package that can use a Clean Base sold separately.
